info.title: Voe API
info.description: The common builder surface of a Voe cell. Workspace routes use bearer tokens; effective capability is the lower of the token's scope and the live grant's ceiling, re-derived on every request.

200.description: Counts, contributing channels, date span, and a short list of connected entities.

get.summary: Paged records beneath a workspace count

200.description: Exact total, a bounded result slice, and nextOffset when more records remain.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: All held records or records heard today.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Result offset. Responses include nextOffset when more records remain.

post.description: Scope: `write`. `Content-Type: text/markdown` captures the body as a page. `application/json` accepts a full capture envelope. Raw input is stored first; rate-limited per workspace.

parameters.name: tier
parameters.description: `all` includes suspicious senders and full-weight unknowns.

get.summary: Token-budgeted context bundle with citations and gaps

parameters.name: entities
parameters.description: Comma-separated entity slugs to lead the bundle.

post.summary: Structured context bundle with an optional graph scope
post.description: Scope: `read`. Use POST when the request includes graphScope.
Scope: `read`. Events: sources, text, citation-warning|withheld, gaps (always last). Strict withholds ungrounded sentences and does not stream.

entities.description: Page slugs that anchor the question to known people, companies, or records.

conversation.description: Prior turns for follow-up continuity. Conversation text is not evidence and cannot support a citation.

get.summary: Bounded graph walk from start slugs

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort by name (default), connection count, or most recent contact.

parameters.description: Result offset. Responses include nextOffset when more records remain.

parameters.name: clock
parameters.description: Clock used to order the timeline.

200.description: The center, selected neighboring records, typed connections, and whether more neighbors remain.

get.description: Scope: `read`. Returns one or two hops around one entity; it never returns a whole-workspace graph.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: One or two hops from the center.

expectedSha256.description: Current body hash precondition - stale is refused.

semanticType.description: Existing or replacement fully qualified domain page type.

semanticType.description: Active, fully qualified domain page type.
